Income tax assessment ongoing from October 2025 search; no final tax amount determined

operating_notes.text: Preferential issue of ₹250.11 Cr (February 2024) funded ALDS, CNG and PCD projects at ₹75 Cr each plus ₹25.11 Cr general corporate purpose; ₹249.09 Cr was utilised as at 31 March 2026.
Q4FY26 Auto LPG performance was subdued as the company prioritised bulk supply for higher margins and PCD supply under the government mandate.
The group now reports a single operating and reportable segment under Ind AS 108, with prior-period segment data retrospectively aligned.
The company recognised an additional ₹149 lakh PF-related liability in Q4FY26 and ₹172 lakh of past-service gratuity and leave liability from the New Labour Codes.
Of the ₹250.11 Cr February 2024 preferential issue, ₹75 Cr each went to Auto LPG, pack LPG cylinder and CNG capex and ₹24.09 Cr to general corporate purposes, leaving ₹1.02 Cr unutilised.

BW LPG Shipping FZCO (formerly BW LPG Infrastructure DMCC), a non-promoter holder, sold its entire 2,82,29,120 shares (8.50%) off-market on 2 June 2026, and all agreements dated 30 November 2023 with it stand terminated.
India's LPG market expected to reach 40-42 MMT by FY2030
Company holds 6% of India's auto LPG market with 77 TMT sales
Auto LPG division targets expansion to 500 stations from current 310+
Packed LPG sales at 18-20,000 metric ton per month, focused on commercial segment
Auto LPG stations: 315 operational, targeting 500 (75 in FY27, 100 in FY28)
CNG stations: 50+ operational, planning additional 50 in Bangalore

timeline.summary: On 2 May 2026, Confidence Petroleum shareholders passed all three EGM special resolutions — appointing M/s. Katariya and Munot as joint statutory auditor, raising Section 180(1)(C) borrowing limits and approving creation of charge — with over 99.99% of votes polled in favour.

On 14 May 2026, Confidence Petroleum filed CARE Ratings' monitoring agency report for the quarter ended 31 March 2026, showing ₹54.80 Cr of its ₹250.11 Cr preferential issue utilised in the quarter and ₹1.02 Cr unutilised, with the utilisation deadline extended to 14 June 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,215.69 Cr (+31.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.07 Cr (+36.3% YoY).
On 30 May 2026, Confidence Petroleum filed its Reg. 32 statement for the quarter ended 31 March 2026, showing ₹249.09 Cr of its ₹250.11 Cr February 2024 preferential issue utilised and no deviation.
On June 4, 2026, Confidence Petroleum confirmed that BW LPG Shipping FZCO divested its entire 8.50% stake on June 2, 2026, terminating all related agreements.
Confidence Petroleum reported Q4FY26 results with revenue of ₹1,216 Cr and EBITDA margin
Confidence Petroleum reported Q1FY27 results with record revenue of ₹2,408 Cr, up 117% YoY, and PAT of ₹62.6 Cr, more than tripling YoY, driven by strong LPG volume growth and diversified sourcing.
